info.title: Cable Billing mobile API
info.description:
The contract between the lineman Android app and the server (PLAN §10). Generated from the Zod schemas in packages/contracts; do not edit openapi.json by hand.

- JSON field names are snake_case. Money is integer paise (*_paise). Instants are ISO-8601 UTC with 'Z'. Business dates and periods are YYYY-MM-DD in India time. Ids are UUIDs.
- Every response, success or error, carries server_time. Errors use the ErrorResponse body with a stable error.code.
- Every request carries the 'x-app-version-code' header (Android versionCode). Authenticated endpoints need 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>'.
- v1 changes are additive only: clients must ignore unknown response fields and unknown feature flags, and map unknown error codes by HTTP status. See packages/contracts/README.md.

login.description: The lineman's login (usually their mobile number). Compared case-insensitively after trimming.

LoginRequest.description: Sign in a lineman on this phone.

install_id.description: Random UUID the app makes once per installation and keeps until it is uninstalled. Identifies this phone's install to the server.

model.description: Phone maker and model (Build.MANUFACTURER + Build.MODEL), e.g. 'Xiaomi Redmi 9A'.

app_version.description: App version name for display and support, e.g. '1.0.3'. Not compared.

app_version_code.description: Android versionCode of the installed app (an integer that grows with every release). The force-update gate compares this, never the version name.

install_id.description: This installation's install_id (must match the token's device).

RefreshRequest.description: Swap the refresh token for a new token pair. Reusing an old refresh token revokes the whole token family (REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID).

refresh_token.description: The refresh token to revoke. Works even when the access token has expired.

LogoutRequest.description: Sign this phone out: revokes the refresh token's family. The app must not delete queued payments (PLAN §9.2).

phone.description: The confirmed or corrected primary mobile number.

UpdatePhoneRequest.description: Correct the customer's primary phone from the receipt flow (FR-004). Audited with source 'android'. Sending the current number again changes nothing.

payments.description: 1–50 queued payments, oldest first. The server posts them in this order.

PaymentBatchRequest.description: Push queued payments. Safe to send again after a timeout or crash.

id.description: Payment id = idempotency key. A UUIDv7 the phone creates before saving the payment locally (FR-015); it never changes, so a retry can never post twice.

amount_paise.description: Amount received, in paise (> 0). The app takes whole rupees (D-17), so this is a multiple of 100 today.

upi_reference.description: UPI reference the lineman typed (optional, only with method 'upi'). Not proof of payment (BR-10). Omit or null when skipped.

notes.description: Optional note. Omit or null for none.

recorded_at.description: When the lineman saved the payment, by the phone's clock (UTC). More than 10 minutes in the future or more than 7 days old → posted_needs_review.

provisional_ref.description: The provisional receipt reference shown to the customer before sync (P-{device_code}-{seq}). Kept forever as an alias of the permanent receipt number (FR-016).

collector_id.description: Id of the user who took the payment (UserInfo.id when it was saved). The server takes identity from the token and flags a mismatch for review; it never trusts this for access.

device_id.description: RegisteredDevice.id of this phone when the payment was saved. A mismatch with the token's device is flagged for review.

PaymentBatchItem.description: One payment saved on the phone (PRD §13.3). upi_reference must be absent for cash.

PaymentMethod.description: How the customer paid: 'cash' or 'upi' (UPI is recorded by hand, not verified).

submission_id.description: Idempotency key for this submission (a new UUID per Submit tap; reuse it when retrying the same submission).

cash_handed_over_paise.description: Cash the lineman hands over, in paise (≥ 0).

discrepancy_reason.description: Required when the cash differs from the server's expected cash (VALIDATION otherwise); omit or null when it matches.

note.description: Optional note (e.g. for 'other'). Omit or null for none.

unsynced_payment_count.description: How many of this day's payments are still on the phone (0 when all synced).

unsynced_cash_paise.description: Total cash of those unsynced payments, in paise (0 when all synced).

HandoverRequest.description: Hand over the day's cash. Allowed while the day is open, submitted or returned; a new submission replaces the previous one. Once accepted: HANDOVER_ALREADY_ACCEPTED.

DiscrepancyReason.description:
Why the cash handed over differs from the expected cash (picked from icon tiles, PLAN §11.3):
- short: less cash than expected.
- extra: more cash than expected.
- pending_sync: some payments are still on the phone, so the server total is behind.
- other: anything else (explain in the note).

actions.description: 1–100 actions, oldest first. Send them after their payments have synced.

id.description: Idempotency key for this action, made on the phone when it happened.

payment_id.description: The payment whose receipt it was.

at.description: When it happened, by the phone's clock (UTC).

ReceiptActionItem.description: One receipt action from the phone's outbox.

ReceiptActionType.description:
What the lineman did with a receipt. Observable states only: never 'sent' or 'delivered' (BR-12, RULE-19).
- printed: the printer accepted the receipt.
- print_failed: printing failed (printer off, no paper, not paired).
- whatsapp_opened: WhatsApp was opened with the message ready.
- sms_opened: the SMS app was opened with the message ready.
- pdf_shared: the receipt PDF was handed to the share sheet or WhatsApp.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

tokens.description: The token pair for this phone. Store it encrypted.

user.description: Who signed in (the collector printed on receipts).

LoginResponse.description: Signed in. Store the tokens encrypted; keep user, operator and device for offline use.

access_token.description: Short-lived access token (about 15 minutes). Opaque; never parse it.

access_token_expires_at.description: When the access token stops working (UTC). Refresh a little before this, or on UNAUTHENTICATED.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token for this device (180 days, sliding). Single use: every refresh returns a new one; store it encrypted and replace the old one atomically.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: When the refresh token expires if it is not used (UTC). Each refresh extends it.

name.description: Display name, printed on receipts as the collector.
Business name, shown in the app and on receipts.

office_phone.description: Office phone for the 'Call office' buttons, digits only (may include a leading +). Null if the operator has not set one.

receipt_footer.description: Footer text the operator wants printed on receipts. Null for none.

OperatorInfo.description: The cable operator this lineman works for.

id.description: Server id of this device registration. Sent back on payments as device_id.

device_code.description: Three-character code unique within the operator, used in provisional receipt references: P-{device_code}-{seq}.

RegisteredDevice.description: This phone as the server registered it.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC).

error.description: The error: stable code plus details for logs.

ErrorResponse.description: Body of every error response (4xx/5xx). The HTTP status follows the code (see ErrorCode).

ErrorCode.description:
Stable machine error code. The app maps it to Hindi/English text and an icon; it never shows `message`.
New codes may be added within v1: map an unknown code by the HTTP status.

- VALIDATION (400): The request is malformed or a value is out of range. `fields` says which.
- NOT_FOUND (404): No such route or entity in this tenant.
- FORBIDDEN (403): This user's role may not do this (PLAN §9.3).
- UNAUTHENTICATED (401): The access token is missing, expired or invalid. Call /auth/refresh once, then retry the request.
- CONFLICT (409): The data changed underneath the request.
- TENANT_READ_ONLY (403): The operator's subscription is read-only (D-13). Collections still work (payments, handovers, receipt links and receipt actions); in the mobile API only the phone-number update can get this.
- ID_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_DATA (409): An idempotency key (payment id, action id, submission id) was already used with a different payload (PLAN §8.4). Never retry it; call the office.
- INVARIANT_VIOLATION (500): A financial invariant would break. Always a server bug; nothing was saved.
- APP_TOO_OLD (426): The app is older than min_app_version_code. Show the full-screen 'Update app' screen; queued payments stay on the phone.
- INVALID_CREDENTIALS (401): Wrong login or password.
- ACCOUNT_DISABLED (403): The user (or the operator) is deactivated. Call the office.
- ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED (403): Only linemen sign in on the Android app; owners and staff use the web.
- REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID (401): The refresh token is unknown, expired or was already used. Sign in again (queued payments are kept).
- DEVICE_REVOKED (401): The owner signed this phone out. Sign in again (queued payments are kept and flagged if another user signs in).
- RATE_LIMITED (429): Too many requests. Wait `retry_after_seconds` (also sent as Retry-After).
- CURSOR_INVALID (400): The sync cursor is unknown or too old. Drop it and start a full sync (no cursor).
- CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND (404): No such customer in this operator (cross-tenant ids also get this).
- PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND (404): The server has no such payment in this operator, usually because it has not synced yet. Keep the request and retry after the payment syncs.
- HANDOVER_ALREADY_ACCEPTED (409): The office already accepted this day's handover; it can no longer change.
- INTERNAL (500): Unexpected server error. Nothing was saved by the failed part; retry later.

path.description: Where the problem is, as a dot path into the request body or parameters, e.g. 'payments.3.amount_paise' or 'query.limit'.

issue.description: Machine reason, e.g. 'too_small', 'invalid_format', 'required'. For logs and tests, not shown to users.

FieldIssue.description: One invalid field in a VALIDATION error.

message.description: Developer-facing English detail for logs. Never shown to users; never contains PII.

request_id.description: Server request id. Shown in diagnostics so support can find the server logs.

fields.description: Only for VALIDATION: the invalid fields. Absent for other codes.

min_app_version_code.description: Only for APP_TOO_OLD: the lowest Android versionCode the server accepts. Absent otherwise.

retry_after_seconds.description: Only for RATE_LIMITED: seconds to wait before retrying. Absent otherwise.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

tokens.description: The new tokens; replace both stored tokens.

RefreshResponse.description: New tokens. The old refresh token no longer works.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

LogoutResponse.description: Signed out (also returned when the token was already revoked or unknown).

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

min_app_version_code.description: The lowest Android versionCode the server accepts. If the installed app is older, show only the full-screen 'Update app' button; queued payments stay on the phone and sync after the update.

operator.description: The lineman's operator (name, office phone, receipt footer).

tenant_mode.description: Whether the operator is in normal or read-only mode.

features.description: Feature flags by name (snake_case). A missing flag means off; unknown flags must be ignored. New flags may appear at any time within v1.

AppConfigResponse.description: Settings the app reads on start and after every sync.

TenantMode.description: 'normal', or 'read_only' when the operator's subscription lapsed (D-13). The app keeps collecting and syncing normally in read_only and shows no banner to linemen.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

customers.description: Active customers that are new or changed since the cursor. Upsert by id.

items.description: A UUID (RFC 9562) as 36 hex characters with dashes; the server sends lower case. Ids are UUIDv7 in practice.

removed_customer_ids.description: Tombstones: customers deactivated since the cursor. Delete them from the phone (queued payments for them are kept and still synced).

next_cursor.description: Where the next page or the next delta sync starts. Always present; store it after applying this page.

has_more.description: True if more changes are waiting: request again at once with next_cursor.

SyncCustomersResponse.description: One page of roster changes, ordered by (updated_at, id). Send gzip-accepting requests: about 1,000 customers fit in under 1 MB gzipped.

code.description: Customer code, unique within the operator (searchable, e.g. '1045').

phone.description: Primary phone as stored (legacy data may not be a clean 10-digit number; confirm before using it, FR-004). Null when missing.

alt_phone.description: Second phone as stored, or null.

address.description: Address as one line of text, or null.

area.description: The customer's area, or null when none is set.

active.description: False when the customer is deactivated. The roster never sends inactive customers (they come as removed_customer_ids); customer detail may.

connections.description: Current connections (active or suspended), oldest first. May be empty.

balance_paise.description: The customer's ledger balance in paise. Positive: the customer owes this much in total. Zero or negative: nothing is due (negative means paid in advance). Show max(balance_paise, 0) as the due amount.

credit_paise.description: Advance (credit) in paise: money paid that is not yet used for any bill. Shown separately from the due (D-14).

updated_at.description: When anything in this row last changed on the server (UTC). Part of the sync order.

RosterCustomer.description: A customer as cached on the phone for search and the customer screen (PLAN §10.3). The roster and the customer detail use the same shape, so the app can upsert either.

name.description: Area name as the operator typed it.

AreaRef.description: The area (locality) a customer belongs to.

vc_number.description: VC (viewing card) number as stored, searched by the number pad. Match on digits; never parse it.

status.description: Whether the connection is on or suspended.

Connection.description: One current connection (VC assignment) of the customer.

ConnectionStatus.description: 'active' or 'suspended' (temporarily off). Disconnected connections are not sent to the phone.

count.description: Number of bills that still have money left to pay.

outstanding_paise.description: Money left to pay on those bills, in paise (the sum of their outstanding amounts).

anyOf.description: A billing period (calendar month), written as its first day: YYYY-MM-01.

oldest_period.description: Month of the oldest unpaid bill (YYYY-MM-01), or null when nothing is unpaid.

OpenBillsSummary.description: Summary of the customer's unpaid bills.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

customer.description: The customer, same shape as a roster row.

open_bills.description: Unpaid bills, oldest first (the order payments are applied, PRD §13.2).

recent_payments.description: The latest payments, newest first (at most 20; the server usually sends 10).

CustomerDetailResponse.description: Fresh customer detail for the customer screen when online. Upsert `customer` into the roster cache.

period.description: The month the bill is for (YYYY-MM-01).

charges_paise.description: This bill's own charges in paise (rent and adjustments of the month; old dues for an opening_balance bill). Excludes earlier months' arrears.

outstanding_paise.description: Money still to pay on this bill, in paise (always > 0 for an open bill).

OpenBill.description: A bill that still has money left to pay.

BillKind.description: 'regular' for a monthly bill, 'opening_balance' for old dues brought in when the operator started using Cable Billing.

payment_id.description: Payment id (the phone's idempotency key for phone payments).

recorded_at.description: When the payment was taken, by the collecting device's clock (UTC).

anyOf.description: Provisional receipt reference made on the phone before sync: P-{device_code}-{local sequence, at least 4 digits}. Linked forever to the permanent receipt number (FR-016).

provisional_ref.description: The phone's provisional reference if the payment was taken on a phone, else null.

collected_by_name.description: Name of the person who took the payment, or null if unknown (migrated data).

reversed.description: True if the owner cancelled (reversed) this payment; its receipt is 'Cancelled'.

RecentPayment.description: One of the customer's latest payments.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

changed.description: True if the number changed; false if it already was this number.

UpdatePhoneResponse.description: The customer after the change. Upsert it into the roster cache.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

results.description: Results in request order, one per item, matched by id.

PaymentBatchResponse.description: One result per request item, in the same order. Replaying a batch gives the same results (duplicates instead of posted).

id.description: The payment id this result is for.

payment.description: The saved payment for posted, duplicate and posted_needs_review; null for rejected and retry_later.

review_reason.description: Why the office must check it; set only for posted_needs_review, else null.

error.description: Why it failed; set only for rejected and retry_later, else null.

PaymentBatchResult.description: The result for one payment. Exactly one of `payment` (saved) or `error` (not saved) is set.

PaymentOutcome.description:
What happened to one payment:
- posted: saved now; `payment` has the permanent receipt.
- duplicate: this id was already saved with the same data; `payment` is the original result.
- posted_needs_review: saved, but the office must check it (see review_reason). The money is safe.
- rejected: not saved and will never be (see error); show 'Call office'. Includes ID_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_DATA.
- retry_later: a temporary server problem for this item; nothing saved. Keep it and send it again later.

receipt_number.description: The permanent receipt number. Replace the provisional reference with it everywhere (keep the link).

recorded_at.description: When it was taken, by the phone's clock (UTC), as sent.

posted_at.description: When the server accepted it (UTC). Show both times where they differ (PRD §13.3).

business_date.description: The India-time day it counts for (from recorded_at): the collection session it belongs to.

allocations.description: Bills this payment paid, oldest first. Empty if it all went to advance.

credit_added_paise.description: Part of this payment kept as advance (credit) because no bill was left to pay, in paise.

balance_after_paise.description: The customer's balance right after this payment was posted, in paise (same meaning as RosterCustomer.balance_paise). A replay returns the same value.

credit_after_paise.description: The customer's advance right after this payment was posted, in paise. A replay returns the same value.

PostedPayment.description: A payment the server has saved: what the final receipt prints (PLAN §11.8).

invoice_id.description: The bill this money went to.

amount_paise.description: How much of this payment went to that bill, in paise.

outstanding_after_paise.description: What was left to pay on that bill right after this payment (0 = fully paid). For the receipt line 'Oct bill paid, Nov bill ₹50 left'.

Allocation.description: Part of a payment applied to one bill (oldest bill first, PRD §13.2).

ReviewReason.description:
Why a posted payment needs an office check (the payment is kept, PRD §13.3):
- customer_inactive: the customer was deactivated before the payment synced.
- collector_inactive: the lineman was deactivated before it synced.
- collector_mismatch: saved by a different user than the one now signed in (PLAN §9.2).
- device_mismatch: saved on a different device registration than the token's.
- recorded_at_out_of_range: recorded_at is > 10 min in the future or > 7 days old (PLAN §10.4).
- other: any other reason the server flags.

message.description: Developer-facing English detail for logs. Never shown to users; never contains PII.

fields.description: Only for VALIDATION: the invalid fields. Absent for other codes.

ItemError.description: Why one item of a batch was rejected.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

session.description: The day's totals, payments and handover.

CollectionDayResponse.description: The lineman's own totals for the day (the Today screen).

HandoverStatus.description:
Where the day's cash handover stands:
- open: not handed over yet.
- submitted: the lineman handed over; the office has not checked it.
- accepted: the office accepted it (final).
- returned: the office sent it back with a note; the lineman can submit again.

submission_id.description: The submission_id of the latest handover.

cash_expected_paise.description: Cash the server expected when the handover was submitted, in paise (server-side cash total; UPI excluded).

cash_handed_over_paise.description: Cash the lineman handed over, in paise.

discrepancy_paise.description: cash_handed_over_paise − cash_expected_paise, computed by the server. Negative = short, positive = extra.

discrepancy_reason.description: The lineman's reason when there is a discrepancy, else null.

unsynced_payment_count.description: Payments still on the phone when the handover was submitted (warning for office).

unsynced_cash_paise.description: Cash of those unsynced payments, in paise, as the phone reported it.

submitted_at.description: When the server received the handover (UTC).

anyOf.description: An instant in UTC as ISO-8601 with a 'Z' suffix (no other offset), e.g. 2026-10-13T05:30:00.000Z. Millisecond precision.

reviewed_at.description: When the office accepted or returned it (UTC), or null while submitted.

review_note.description: The office's note when it returned (or accepted) the handover, or null.

Handover.description: The latest cash handover for the day.

recorded_at.description: When it was taken, by the phone's clock (UTC).

anyOf.description: Provisional receipt reference made on the phone before sync: P-{device_code}-{local sequence, at least 4 digits}. Linked forever to the permanent receipt number (FR-016).

provisional_ref.description: The phone's provisional reference, or null for a payment not taken on a phone.

reversed.description: True if the owner reversed it; reversed payments are not in the totals.

DayPayment.description: A payment the server has for this lineman and day.

cash_total_paise.description: Cash collected (server-known, not reversed), in paise: the cash the office expects.

upi_total_paise.description: UPI collected (server-known, not reversed), in paise. Not part of the cash handover.

payment_count.description: Number of server-known payments, not reversed.

handover.description: The latest handover, or null while status is open.

payments.description: The day's server-known payments by this lineman, newest first (including reversed ones, flagged).

CollectionDay.description: The lineman's collection session for one business date (PLAN §8.7). All zero with status 'open' if nothing was collected.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

session.description: The day's totals, payments and handover.

HandoverResponse.description: The day after the handover (status 'submitted'). Repeating the same submission_id returns the current state.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

ReceiptLinkResponse.description: A usable preview link for the payment's receipt: an existing unexpired one or a new one. Online only.

url.description: The public preview page (https, unguessable token). Put it in the WhatsApp/SMS text as is.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working (90 days, D-14), UTC.

ReceiptLink.description: A receipt preview link (FR-021). The page shows minimal personal data.

server_time.description: Server clock when the response was made (UTC). The phone uses it to spot a wrong device clock and to label 'Updated X min ago'.

results.description: Results in request order, one per item, matched by id.

ReceiptActionsResponse.description: One result per request item, in the same order.

id.description: The action id this result is for.

error.description: Why it was not saved; set only for rejected and retry_later, else null.

ReceiptActionResult.description: The result for one receipt action.

ReceiptActionOutcome.description:
What happened to one action:
- recorded: saved now.
- duplicate: already saved with the same data.
- rejected: invalid and never will be saved (see error); drop it from the outbox.
- retry_later: not saved yet (e.g. PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND because the payment has not synced); keep it and send again later.

bearerAuth.description: The access_token from /auth/login or /auth/refresh. On UNAUTHENTICATED, refresh once and retry.
